principles: The JSON example is the de-facto spec — fix the example, not just the prose
Amend in place; preserve the doc's existing correlation/supersedes/authority/privacy design
Preserve provider fidelity (raw units) AND add a normalized canonical view; never force one shape
Never bake absolute prices into append records — reference a pricing snapshot
Documentation-only: no source code in this story
drivers: A two-field token model systematically under-counts and makes cost impossible (cache reads ~0.1x, writes 1.25x/2x; input_tokens is uncached remainder)
Fixing the spec pre-implementation is far cheaper than after a writer ships
User needs accurate per-story token + cost accounting

options.name: A: amend the existing doc in place
cons: Must keep edits consistent with many existing sections

options.name: B: rewrite the doc
cons: Throws away well-designed sections; large risky diff — rejected

options.name: C: write a second addendum doc
cons: Splits the spec; readers miss the correction — rejected

chosen: A: amend the existing doc in place
rationale: The doc's correlation/supersedes/authority/privacy design is sound; only the token model and a few accuracy rules are wrong or missing. In-place amendment yields a small, reviewable diff and one canonical spec, at the cost of keeping edits consistent with existing sections — mitigated by a final cross-reference pass (CHK-009) and a whole-doc reviewer read.

preMortem.scenario: Four-field model added to prose but the JSON example still shows input/output/total
preMortem.mitigation: CHK-001 explicitly covers both prose and example; verifier greps the example block for all four field names and asserts totalTokens absent

preMortem.scenario: Edits contradict the existing correlation/supersedes/authority sections
preMortem.trigger: New text duplicates or conflicts with existing rules
preMortem.mitigation: CHK-009 cross-reference pass + reviewer reads the whole doc end to end; verifier checks key invariants still appear once

preMortem.scenario: Scope creep into source code / a real schema file
preMortem.mitigation: Execution boundary excludes packages/*/src; scope contract enforced at REVIEW; verifier asserts only the one doc changed

preMortem.scenario: Required record constraints / Validation / Acceptance not updated to match new fields
preMortem.mitigation: CHK-009 + the product-reviewer advisory (clarify the four fields in Required record constraints); verifier checks those sections mention cache fields

preMortem.scenario: A doc gate (e.g. English-surface / no-new-Chinese) fails
preMortem.trigger: Non-English content or formatting issue introduced
preMortem.mitigation: Keep all additions English; run lattice validate before advancing
